extracted.name: Radish Cream Cheese Spread
extracted.description: This easy spread with cream cheese, radishes, and dill tastes great on any kind of bread or you can serve it with crackers as an appetizer.
instruction_lines: Combine cream cheese and milk in a bowl and stir until smooth. Mix in radishes and dill.
